references.text: Caleb refers to being forty years old when Moses sent him, and the context shows that the conquest took many years
Caleb mentions that forty-five years have passed since the Lord spoke this word, indicating the long time Joshua led the war
The prophecy that Israel would wander in the wilderness for forty years before they could enter the land
Moses predicted that the Lord would drive out the nations little by little, not all at once
God promised to drive out the peoples gradually over time, not in one year
